items.body_raw: לֹא שָׁמַרְתָּ בְּרִיתִי
items.answer_raw: Thou hast not kept my covenant.

items.body_raw: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ תּוֹרָתֶךָ
items.answer_raw: They have not kept thy law.

items.body_raw: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ בְּכָל־לִבִּי
items.answer_raw: I have kept thy statutes with all my heart.

items.body_raw: לֹא זָכְרָה אַחֲרִיתָהּ
items.answer_raw: She did not remember her latter end.

items.body_raw: שָׁכְחוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם
אֶת־קוֹלְךָ שָׁמַעְנוּ מִן־הָאֵשׁ
items.answer_raw: Thy voice we heard out of the fire.

items.body_raw: אֲנִי יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־מְכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי מִצְרָיְמָה
items.answer_raw: I am Joseph whom ye sold into Egypt.

items.body_raw: לָמָּה נָפְלוּ פָנֶיךָ
שָׁפְכוּ דָמִים כַּמָּיִם
שְׂרַפְתֶּם אֶת־הָעִיר בָּאֵשׁ
items.answer_raw: Ye burned the city with fire.

items.body_raw: רָאָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהִנֵּה טוֹב מְאֹד
items.answer_raw: God saw all that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

items.body_raw: אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל אֶל־הָעָם אֶת־שׁוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וַחֲמוֹר מִי לָקַחְתִּי וְאֶת־מִי עָשַׁקְתִּי וּמִיַּד מִי לָקַחְתִּי כֹפֶר וְכָל־הָעָם אָמַר לֹא עָשַׁקְתָּ אִישׁ וְלֹא לָקַחְתָּ מִיַּד אִישׁ מְאוּמָה
items.answer_raw: Samuel said to the people, Whose ox have I taken or whose ass have I taken, or whom have I oppressed, or from whose hand have I taken a bribe? And all the people said, Thou hast oppressed no one, and thou hast not taken anything from the hand of any one.

items.body_raw: עָף אֵלַי אֶחָד מִן־הַשְּׂרָפִים וּבְיָדוֹ רִצְפָּה בְּמֶלְקָחַיִם לָקַח מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ
items.answer_raw: There flew to me one of the seraphs, with a glowing stone in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

items.body_raw: עמדה האשה לפני המלך
items.answer_raw: The woman stood before the king.

items.body_raw: שבת אלהים ביום השביעי מהמלאכה אשר עשה
items.answer_raw: God rested on the seventh day from the work which he had made.

items.body_raw: Ye did not keep my words.
The fire of God fell from heaven.
God set (gave) luminaries in the firmament of the heavens.
All the males fell before the sword.
The heavens of the heavens are God's (dat.), and the earth he has given to the sons of man.
items.answer_raw: שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמַיִם לֵאלֹהִים וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי אָדָם

items.body_raw: Thou hast fallen, O (art.) city, in the heart of the sea.
I kept my tongue from evil words.
These (are) the proverbs of Solomon the wise king of Israel.
items.answer_raw: אֵלֶּה מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל הֶחָכָם

items.body_raw: We heard his voice from his temple.
Their faces fell.
We leant our hands upon her head.
The blessing of Yahweh (be) upon thy children (sons).
We sat by (עַל) the waters of the great rivers.
Ye have burnt their city in the fire.
She bare to her husband a son to his old age.
They have forgotten my words and the proverbs of my lips.
